summary: A unit aggregate two-row wedge plus the three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis does not force a universal lower bound on the rank-one hub-pair resource |sigma| ||H n||. The explicit family A_k has at least three eigenvalues of modulus >=1, Delta(H)=1, all physical coefficients O(1/k), all physical 2x2 principal determinants O(1/k^2), but |sigma| ||H n||=1/k^2 ->0. For k>=129 it lies in the strict local no-pivot chamber. This refutes only core-only scale forcing, not QFORM. The same family is uniformly paid by the determinant-balanced two-hub Pluecker theorem with continuous density <3.157, so the replacement route is augmented-frame disjointness versus physical localization.
